items.title: Jax Taylor Reveals Cancer Diagnosis After 'Private' Health Battle
items.summary:
Jax Taylor is opening up about a recent health scare, revealing he was diagnosed with cancer .

“This is something I’ve kept private for the past few months because it’s been one of the scariest times of my life,” the Vanderpump Rules alum, 47, wrote via Instagram on Wednesday, November 18. “Back in July, I woke up one morning in horrible pain and ended up in the hospital with kidney stones. What I thought was just a kidney stone turned into something I never imagined. My CT scan also showed a tumor on my left kidney. After many tests and appointments I found out it was cancer.”

Taylor continued, “I lost my father to cancer, so hearing that word just broke me. It put me in a really dark place. The hardest part was the waiting. Knowing there was a tumor growing inside me while trying to go about my life like everything was fine. It’s crazy how you can act like everything is normal when deep down you’re a mess.”

Jax Taylor Through the Years: All the Highs and Lows of ‘The Valley’ Star 

The former reality star noted that he had a five-hour surgery that day to remove the tumor, “but it was a lot larger than they thought so we are waiting on the pathology results.”

Taylor included several photos and videos of himself in the hospital while reflecting on what he learned from the experience.

Courtesy Jax Taylor/Instagram 
 “It’s been eye opening,” he wrote before giving a shout-out to girlfriend Lori Krebs . “I honestly don’t know how I would have gotten through everything without my amazing girlfriend by my side. She’s been my rock through all of this. She’s not just my…
items.t: Jax Taylor Reveals Cancer Diagnosis After 'Private' Health Battle

items.title: Actor Alexander Haskin Dead at 38, Pulled From Water Near Santa Monica Pier

Authorities responded to a report of someone in the ocean at around 4:06 p.m. local time. Haskin was pronounced dead just before 5 p.m.

The L.A. Times and TMZ reported that Haskin’s cause of death has been deferred pending further investigation by the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner’s Office.

The statement continued, “Harbor Guards conducted an underwater search, located the individual and brought him aboard a lifeguard boat, where CPR began. After being hoisted onto the pier deck, Santa Monica Fire Department paramedics continued lifesaving measures. Despite their efforts, he was pronounced deceased at 4:56 p.m.”

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. I did not mean to imply or cause a reasonable person to infer that Sir David is standing on Brixton high street kicking a Poundland. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).
